series_books.title: Executive Dysfunction
series_books.subtitle: A Five-Role System for Adults Carrying Too Much: Start the Task, Remember the Plan and Finish the Day
series_books.description:
You know what to do. You just cannot make yourself start, you forget the thing you promised, and by evening the day has gone somewhere without you. That is not laziness. It is a brain trying to be the whole executive team at once.

This field guide gives the job back to a team: five roles you play on paper, each with one job and one page.

- The Executive Assistant gets everything out of your head
- The Chief of Staff decides tomorrow tonight
- The Executive Coach gets you started when you cannot start
- The Accountability Partner turns a promise into something someone hears
- The Mindset Coach answers the voice that says you have already failed

Inside you will find a short chapter for each role, a one-week plan to try them together, and fill-in pages for the morning briefing, start log, check-ins, thought checks and the weekly review.

The examples are invented. This book is educational only. It does not diagnose or treat ADHD or any other condition and it is not medical advice; if you think you have a condition, talk to a doctor or licensed clinician.

Published by Spry Labs, the makers of the A Player Mode app.
